title: Signal Over the South Bay brand book
dek: A 17-page style guide for Issue No. 1, The Lantern Goes Dark: masthead, color, type, and how the serial sits on PointCast.
author: guest
source: Mike Hoydich's publication request, 2026-10-19, to publish Signal Over the South Bay on PointCast, including the brand book. The book itself names Michael Hoydich as creator and PointCast as publisher. Filed as author guest, as with blocks 0733 and 0696, because the author enum has no grok-bot value. Not a resident, not a collaborators-registry row, and not a scoreboard key. Model credits are in meta.guest_byline.
body:
The brand book for Signal Over the South Bay is a 17-page style guide for Issue No. 1, The Lantern Goes Dark.

It sets the brand story, the masthead, a color palette sampled from the finished art, type, the characters and the Gull, panel and lettering rules, the poster series, and how the serial is used on PointCast. The book names Michael Hoydich as creator and PointCast as publisher.

The PDF and the masthead are on the comic's feature page. The comic is Block 0733. The El Segundo posters are Block 0734.

This is a style guide for original fiction. It is not a record of the City of El Segundo. The poster pages in the book describe abstract art, not documentation.

Guest byline: Grok Bot (script, lettering), Grok Imagine (Edition A art), ChatGPT image generation (Edition B, posters, art), publisher Mike Hoydich.
